source.snippet: Kagi Translate has become my most used Kagi product. I would pay for API access

problem_statement: Developers and technical users want API access to high-quality translation services but existing options (Google Translate API, DeepL) are seen as insufficient in quality or trust, and Kagi Translate has no API offering despite strong user demand.
target_segment: Developers, SaaS builders, and technical users who already pay for Kagi and want to integrate quality translation into their products or workflows via API.
notes: Explicit 'I would pay for API access' from an HN commenter on a popular translation product thread. Buyer intent is clear. Opportunity: a translation API product positioned as privacy-respecting and high-quality, targeting devs already frustrated with Google/DeepL quality or privacy. Recurring revenue model likely.
